second_order: recruiting people to put Bowie on r/place
theme_note: These calls and joiners bring people into making the Bowie portrait, from the first proposal through the defence call.

second_order: passing around the template, coordinates, and places to organise
theme_note: People repeatedly ask for and supply the practical guides and venues needed to find and reproduce the portrait.
Participants notice the work, call it cool or the best thing on the canvas, thank one another, and value being part of it while it is underway.
This single proposal expands the portrait into a different shared image and belongs with no other practice in the case.

theme_note: These passages report interference, call for defence, switch effort to the memorial, and later recount nearly losing it.

second_order: keeping Bowie's eyes and skin looking right
theme_note: People monitor changing features, complain about damage, debate eye colour, and correct the portrait toward Bowie's appearance.

theme_note: After placement ends, people call the result lovely, congratulate everyone, credit the starter, connect it to Bowie and neighbouring art, and treat completion as shared achievement.
